title: Capture private Tuya identity publication custody
objective: Close credential-bearing private identity publication races while preserving admitted-root authority, exact writer digest fencing, secure cleanup, and package/field contracts before composition.

blockers.reason: Recovery #2858 supersedes stale #2755 and is active at exact cb72a47ee2489235febd40ac440bc9f8462ba432. It correctly closes staging-name regular/directory/symlink substitution by rebinding the source name to the sealed inode immediately before publication and making pre-publication cleanup inode-authoritative; its narrowed four-case Publication Races gate 31475822468 is terminal SUCCESS. Exact source review still finds TWO previously accepted #2767 publication invariants unresolved: (1) same-inode same-size payload overwrite remains accepted because post-publication validation checks dev/ino/link/size but never re-reads final descriptor bytes/digest against the intended payload; (2) if post-publication validation later rejects, exception cleanup still targets `temporary_name`, which is absent after rename, so a contaminated canonical final destination can remain. Restore the #2767 same-inode attack and close final-byte binding plus exact-owned final cleanup/quarantine without blindly deleting unrelated prior identity. Xcode is skipped and Selective Graft is red on this exact head; Field Provenance is queued. Green narrowed red-team is ingredient evidence only.

Production shell order remains correct: checkout FD admission precedes writer-byte capture, digest fence, then hidden credential reads. Recovery #2858 has not yet absorbed #2733's unique source-contract assertion that mechanically locks `root admission -> writer byte capture -> digest fence -> credentials`; the existing weaker test only proves admission/digest precede credentials. Preserve #2733's regression in the final recovery so later refactors cannot reopen the checkout-replacement interval while satisfying the weaker contract.

Inherited Field Build Provenance on the private-identity lineage previously reached the writer self-test on macOS and failed because trusted temporary `/var` ancestry may traverse the platform `/var -> /private/var` symlink while absolute no-follow root admission rejects it. Fix only the trusted self-test root/canonicalization path; do not weaken production admitted-checkout no-symlink custody. Revalidate on the eventual moved exact recovery after final writer bytes/digest/package contracts stabilize.
